To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the electron density distributions for a number of silicate structures, as well as the SiO bond critical point properties for a relatively large set of silicate structures are consistent with the hypothesis that the SiO bond in silicates is a shared covalent one.

the experimental bond critical point properties for the SiO bonds in the silica polymorph coestie, together with those calculated for a number of silicates, are in general in agreement with those predicted by the calculations, and they correlate with the SiO bond lengths in the manner expected from the calculations.

the experimental electron density distributions for coesite and stishovite display a range of bond critical point properties that conform with the calculated values for the SiO bond in the very high-pressure stishovite structure.
